note: What the Waypoint clients say for every state and cause their service reports, and when they send a failure report on their own. One phrase per code in English and Russian: the macOS and Windows clients are tested against this file, and a new code is added here with its phrase. A phrase is picked by the state, then by the cause code ('error'), and where it differs by a condition, by that condition: 'full' (all traffic goes into the tunnel), 'open' (services go direct without the tunnel), 'idle' (no service assigned), 'wanted' (the person switched access on). '{code}' in a phrase is replaced by the cause code. A platform without a 'when' entry never reports that row.

auto_report.note: A client reports a failure of the program itself, never of the environment. Specs: macos-rework 2.7, windows-rework 3.2. Nothing is sent before the person has answered the question once; until then failures wait in the queue.

failures.when: a crash report of the program is newer than the last one sent; looked for at launch
a crash report of the daemon is newer than the last one sent; looked for at launch
the service process fell and the service control manager restarted it
a step of the daemon ended with an internal error
the packet filter anchor is loaded but does not act
the filters were removed from outside and restoring them did not help in 5 attempts
the filtering engine restarted and the filters did not come back in 5 attempts, or it was not there for a minute after start
the VPN connection was changed outside the program and could not be made again in 5 attempts
the service cannot start because the permissions of its folder were changed
the watchdog found a step stalled and restarted the daemon or service
a reset left its mark for more than 10 minutes
damage that cannot be repaired by itself: the service waits in needs_reset
profile_mode returned after the profile was installed
an update failed its signature or checksum check; nothing was installed

never_reported.note: Caused by the environment or by an administrator's decision: the person sees them as a phrase, the developer learns nothing from them.

limits.repeats: counted, and added once a day as a message to the same report
